name: RSS/Atom 数据源
author: MFlow built-in
desc: 拉取 RSS/Atom feed 到 Data Ingestion 目录，作为情报监测的补充源
entry_code:
"""rss-source: collect() 拉取 RSS/Atom → 输出 JSON。MFlow 插件规范 v1。"""
import json, os, re, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path


def collect(url="", out_dir=""):
    if not url:
        raise ValueError("config.url 未配置")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=20) as r:
        raw = r.read().decode("utf-8", "ignore")
    items = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"<item[\s\S]*?</item>", raw):
        b = m.group(0)
        t = re.search(r"<title>(?:<!\\[CDATA\\[)?([\s\S]*?)(?:\\]\\]>)?</title>", b)
        l = re.search(r"<link>([\s\S]*?)</link>", b)
        d = re.search(r"<pubDate>([\s\S]*?)</pubDate>", b)
        items.append({"title": (t.group(1).strip() if t else ""),
                      "link": (l.group(1).strip() if l else ""),
                      "date": (d.group(1).strip() if d else "")})
    if not items:
        for m in re.finditer(r"<entry[\s\S]*?</entry>", raw):
            b = m.group(0)
            t = re.search(r"<title>(?:<!\\[CDATA\\[)?([\s\S]*?)(?:\\]\\]>)?</title>", b)
            l = re.search(r'href="([^"]+)"', b)
            d = re.search(r"<published>([\s\S]*?)</published>", b)
            items.append({"title": (t.group(1).strip() if t else ""),
                          "link": (l.group(1) if l else ""),
                          "date": (d.group(1).strip() if d else "")})
    out = out_dir or os.environ.get("LOVART_LOCAL_DEV_ROOT", ".")
    p = Path(out) / "Output" / "Data Ingestion"
    p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    f = p / "rss-source-latest.json"
    f.write_text(json.dumps({"url": url, "count": len(items), "items": items[:100]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    return {"count": len(items), "path": str(f)}

name: Schema.org JSON-LD Generator
author: MFlow built-in
entry_code:
"""schema-generator: transform(text, config) -> JSON-LD string"""
import json, re
from datetime import datetime

def transform(text, config=None):
    slug = (config or {}).get("slug", "untitled")
    lang = (config or {}).get("lang", "en")
    title_m = re.search(r"#\s+(.+)", text)
    title = title_m.group(1) if title_m else slug
    desc_m = re.search(r"description:\s*(.+)", text)
    desc = desc_m.group(1) if desc_m else ""
    now = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S+08:00")
    if lang != "en":
        url = f"https://www.lovart.ai/{lang}/blog/{slug}"
    else:
        url = f"https://www.lovart.ai/blog/{slug}"
    return json.dumps({
        "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "Article",
        "headline": title[:110], "description": desc[:160], "url": url,
        "author": {"@type": "Organization", "name": (config or {}).get("author", "Lovart")},
        "publisher": {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Lovart"},
        "datePublished": now, "dateModified": now, "inLanguage": lang
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
